scopedObservations: All 36 reviewed scripts retain coherent 11-turn exchange and five Player targets. No numeric causal inconsistency observed, including 60000/100000=60%, 60000/120000=50%, Gujo denominations total 30000.

Earlier bank/post scripts use repeated not-assume/separate-records language and generic future handoff more than final city scripts. These are style/variety risks; avoid stating broad stylistic perfection.

Seki transparent-envelope and Mizuho internal-box-number plots share personal-data concealment motivation but operate on different exposure surfaces and packaging choices. No concrete noun-swap conclusion from the full exchanges alone.
Full prior comparisons were not conducted for the other32 in this reviewer pass; existing cluster evidence must supply that gate.
unresolvedRisks: Bank form/fee/availability facts are fictional services, not general guarantees.
Bounded retrieved counterpart coverage cannot prove global semantic uniqueness.

previousBlockers.reason: Same planned household payment versus actual bank debit misunderstanding and same verification/separate-future-memo outcome. Different phrasing does not establish independent scenario.
